Meteorological forecasting system
*341. SHRI R. P. GOENKA: Will the
Minister of SCIENCE AND
TECHNOLOGY be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have analysed
the shortcomings in the present
meteorological forecasting system;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether it is a fact that a proposal
has been formulated to procure some hi-
tech world class equipment worth Rs. 500
crores to secure better overall
meteorological forecasting and even for
district-wise predictions; and
(d) if so, the details thereof and its
present status?
Recruitment of ex-Servicemen to
guard U.S. installation in Iraq
*342. SHRIMATI JAYA BACHCHAN:
SHRI AMAR SINGH:
Will the Minister of LABOUR AND
EMPLOYMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have made any
investigation into the incidents of some
Indian companies smuggling ex-
servicemen into Iraq from Kuwait and
Jordan to guard U.S. installation there;
(b) if so, the details thereof including
the names of companies which had
recruited these ex-servicemen and what is
the number of such recruits; and
(c) what action Government have taken
against them?
Private Investment in Nuclear Energy
Sector
†*343. SHRI P.K. MAHESHWARI:
Will the Minister of ATOMIC ENERGY
be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are
considering to encourage private investors
in the nuclear energy sector;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) the number of units functioning in
the above said sector along with the unit-
wise production thereof; and
(d) the details of the other important

steps Government are taking to increase the
nuclear power generation besides inviting
private investment?
Theft of coal
†*344. SHRI RAMADHAR
KASHYAP: Will the PRIME MINISTER
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that a number of
complaints have been received with regard
to the theft of coal from Gevara/Deepika
area of South Eastern Coalfields Ltd;
(b) whether it is a fact that keeping in
view the seriousness of the matter in
pursuance of their enquiry the State
Government have demanded a C.B.I.
enquiry;
(c) if so, the details thereof;
(d) whether any action has been taken
or proposed in this regard, so far; and
(e) if so, the details thereof?
CAG’s report on BSNL and MTNL
†*345. SHRI MOTILAL VORA:
SHRI UDAY PRATAP
SINGH:
Will the Minister of
COMMUNICATIONS AND
INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the CAG has
severely criticised the working of
Mahanagar Telephone Nigam Ltd. and
Bharat Sanchar Nigam Ltd;
(b) if so, the details thereof and the
value of the machines which could not be
utilised by the said Nigams;
(c) the level at which a decision was
taken to purchase these machines and what
were the reasons therefor; and
(d) the steps Government are taking to
provide better facilities to the consumers?
Call girls from Central Asian countries
coming to India on tourist Visas
*346. DR. NARAYAN SINGH
MANAKLAO: Will the Minister of
EXTERNAL AFFAIRS be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that call girls from
Central Asian countries are coming to India
with tourist visa;
(b) if so, the volume of such traffic;
(c) what deterrent steps are being taken
by the visa granting authorities in these
countries to check the antecedents of the
potential call girls;
(d) whether there is any functional
coordination mechanism and information
sharing arrangement between Ministry of
External Affairs  and Ministry of Home
Affairs to control the menace; and
(e) if so, the details thereof?
Grant to States for project
implementation
*347. SHRI  VIJAY J. DARDA: Will
the PRIME MINISTER be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that during
2003-04 the Planning Commission granted
Rs. 33,000 crore to the States for Plan
Projects implementation, but States
incurred a debt of Rs. 85,000 crore  to fund
the balance of plan expenditure;
(b) if so, what percentage of Rs 85,000
crore constitutes the expenditure incurred
by the States on account of their share; and
(c) if not, the actual availability of funds
required by States for implementation of
such projects?
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

National Advisory CouncilNational Advisory Council
1624. SHRI ARUN JAITLEY:
SHRI SHAHID SIDDIQUI:
SHRI S.S. AHLUWALIA:
Will the PRIME MINISTER be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that a National
Advisory Council has been constituted in
June, 2004;
(b) if so, the details thereof including its
legal and constitutional position and the
organizational structure of the Council;
(c) the details of the expenditure
earmarked, relationship with Prime Minister’s
Office, the objectives, functions,
responsibilities, accountability and authorities,
if any, entrusted to the said Council; and
(d) brief details about antecedents of
individuals inducted as members thereof?
Cottage industries in Rajasthan andCottage industries in Rajasthan and
PunjabPunjab
1625. SHRI SANTOSH BAGRODIA :
Will the Minister of AGRO AND RURAL
INDUSTRIES be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have received
any proposals from the State
Governments of Rajasthan and Punjab for
developing Cottage Industries in the States;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) the details of the funds allocated for
this purpose during the last three years to
the States and the rate of development of
Cottage Industries in the States?
Projects of Kerala Agro IndustriesProjects of Kerala Agro Industries
CorporationCorporation
1626. SHRI A. VIJAYARAGHAVAN:
Will the Minister of AGRO AND RURAL
INDUSTRIES be pleased to state:
(a) whether many projects submitted
by the Kerala Agro Industries Corporation
are under the consideration of the
Competent Authority;
(b) if so, the action taken thereon;
(c) if so, the details of such proposals
under the consideration of the Competent
Authority;

Agro Clinics and Agro Business Centres,
establishing godowns in rural areas in

(e) if so, the details thereof?
Disposal of radio-active sourcesDisposal of radio-active sources
1627. SHRIMATI KAMLA
MANHAR : Will the PRIME MINISTER
be pleased to state:
(a) whether the Atomic Energy
Commission (AEC) is facing any problem
in disposal of radio-active sources used for
medical purposes in India;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) what is the system of disposal of
radio-active sources used by AEC in India?
FDI in mining sectorFDI in mining sector
1628. SHRIMATI S.G. INDIRA : Will
the PRIME MINISTER be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the
Government have approved about Rs. 4,000
crores of foreign direct investment in mining
sector;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether the country had been
dificient in high value minerals because of
low investment and lack of advanced
technology required for detailed
exploration;
(d) whether Government are considering
to provide incentives to boost private
investment and to make industry more
productive and competitive; and
(e) if so, the details thereof?
Terminal benefit to employees ofTerminal benefit to employees of
Bharat Gold Mines Ltd.Bharat Gold Mines Ltd.
1629. SHRIMATI S.G. INDIRA : Will
the PRIME MINISTER be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that more than
3,000 employees of Bharat Gold Mines
Limited, which was closed in 2001, are yet
to receive terminal benefit;
(b) whether Government had received
any representation in this regard from the
employees of B.G.M. Ltd.;
(c) whether Government are considering
to provide revival package for B.G.M. Ltd.;
and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
Employment to land losers inEmployment to land losers in
Basundhara West ProjectBasundhara West Project
1630. SHRI JIBON ROY: Will the
PRIME MINISTER be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that an agreement
was made on 16th January, 2001 regarding
employment of land losers in Basundhara
West Project; and
(b) if so, how many land losers have so
far been appointed?
Setting up of coal washery by SECLSetting up of coal washery by SECL
†1631. SHRI RAMADHAR
KASHYAP: Will the PRIME MINISTER
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that South Eastern
Coalfields Limited (SECL) has provided
land on lease to M/s. Iron Coal Benefication
Private Limited to set up Washery;
(b) if so, whether SECL was authorised
to provide the land on lease which was
acquired for extracting coal;
